title: knautia arvensis subsp. pannonica
intro: Knautia arvensis subsp. pannonica, commonly known as Field Scabious, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Dipsacaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to aid in respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its ability to soothe and calm the airways. The health benefits of Knautia arvensis subsp. pannonica include its anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce swelling and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects.
